<!--
Pull requests to Starship go through the no-mistakes review pipeline.
Push through `git push no-mistakes` instead of pushing a branch yourself: it reviews, tests and checks the change, then opens this pull request for you and fills in this template.
A pull request opened another way fails the "Require no-mistakes" check and is not reviewed or merged.
CONTRIBUTING.md explains the setup.

How to fill this in:
- Write the four short sections for a person who has one minute and has not read the code.
- Use plain words: name what a person notices, not file, function or flag names.
- Keep every top-level heading below, in this order, and replace each comment with your text.
- Add no "Generated with" or other tool credit line anywhere.
- Test results are added below this text automatically, so do not repeat them here.
-->
